title: SQL Server: a column added after the first load arrives without a full refresh (standard CDC and change tracking)

found.by: 2026-10-26 test round: SQL Server 2022 CU27, standard gateway, standard CDC and change tracking, one run each

symptom: ADD COLUMN after the first load: the gateway logged "Detected a schema change", and the next update COMPLETED with the column added. Rows from before the change are NULL in it; the new row carries its value.
cause: The gateway detects the change, and the update adds the column to the destination.
effect: Rows from before the change have NULL in the new column.
fix: None needed. Full refresh only if the older rows must hold the new column's values.
notes: One row before and one after the change. Defaults and computed columns are covered by lfc-schema-change-test, not by this run.
